title: A sign-in return that is not completed opens as a guest with no message
evidence: claimRedirectCode (widget-src/src/storage/pkce.ts) does not complete a return whose PKCE entry carries an older log-off id: it strips code and state from the address and the page opens as a guest. The existing line in connect.ts reportConnectFailure, '<provider> did not connect, so nothing changed. Please try again.', is not used: its 'so nothing changed' need not hold here. Candidate words: '<provider> sign-in did not complete. Please try again.' or 'Your <provider> sign-in did not finish. You can sign in again from Sign in.'
